INSERT INTO voice_user_tiers (user_id, tier, valid_until, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
                    valid_until = EXCLUDED.valid_until,
                    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
                WHERE voice_user_tiers.updated_at <= EXCLUDED.updated_at
